title: Add Completed keypoint diagnosis panel
summary: Replace the verbose default Completed selected-row working surface with a compact read-only diagnosis card that highlights why an output looks different.
reason: Operators need to quickly identify the key evidence behind size/route differences while flipping between Completed rows, without reading a long raw detail dump by default.
behavior_before: The Completed selected-file panel led with a broad evidence grid and always-visible raw selected-row detail text, making size-growth investigation noisy.
behavior_after: The Completed selected-file panel leads with a concise diagnosis line, key signals, evidence gaps, and next checks while preserving raw detail behind a collapsed disclosure.
